digest.component_or_area: HLC (Hybrid Logical Clock) implementation and store subsystem
propositions: The REBAR_HLC=0 environment variable and _enabled flag in hlc.py remain in codebase despite being deprecated in the remediation plan and should be removed to prevent reintroduction of causal-ordering errors.
REBAR_HLC_NOW must be retained as the sole test-time physical-clock injection mechanism while all disable-branch logic is removed.
Compaction concurrency test scenarios A and B must be migrated to use ordered forward REBAR_HLC_NOW injection values and real engine operations instead of relying on the disabled HLC switch.
The seam marker budget in test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py must be reduced from 2 to 1 for hlc.py and from 5 to 4 total as the read-via marker is removed.
An exact-name oracle must be added to prevent REBAR_HLC from being reintroduced while allowing REBAR_HLC_NOW to remain functional.
